items.sql:
SELECT
    p.product_name,
    p.brand,
    lp.price_eur,
    lp.last_price_date,
    lp.rating,
    lp.reviews,
    p.skroutz_link
FROM mv_latest_prices lp
JOIN products p ON lp.id = p.id
WHERE p.last_seen = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM price_snapshots)
  AND lp.category = 'phone'
ORDER BY lp.price_eur NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

SELECT
    product_name,
    brand,
    price_eur,
    last_price_date,
    rating,
    reviews,
    skroutz_link
FROM mv_latest_prices
WHERE category = 'laptop'
  AND last_price_date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM price_snapshots)
ORDER BY price_eur DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

SELECT
    category,
    COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM
    products
GROUP BY
    category
ORDER BY
    product_count DESC
LIMIT 50

SELECT COUNT(*) AS price_count
FROM price_snapshots
WHERE date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM price_snapshots)
LIMIT 50

SELECT
    product_name,
    brand,
    drop_date,
    prev_price,
    new_price,
    drop_eur,
    skroutz_link
FROM vw_biggest_drops
WHERE drop_date >= (SELECT MAX(date) FROM price_snapshots) - INTERVAL '7 days'
ORDER BY drop_eur ASC
LIMIT 1

items.sql:
WITH latest AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS latest_date
    FROM price_snapshots
)
SELECT
    d.product_name,
    d.brand,
    d.model,
    d.drop_date,
    d.prev_price,
    d.new_price,
    d.drop_pct
FROM vw_biggest_drops d
CROSS JOIN latest
WHERE d.category = 'laptop'
  AND d.drop_date >= latest.latest_date - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND d.drop_date <= latest.latest_date
ORDER BY d.drop_pct ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dropped_products
FROM vw_biggest_drops
WHERE drop_date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM price_snapshots)
LIMIT 50

SELECT COUNT(*) AS new_products_count
FROM products
WHERE first_seen >= (
    SELECT MAX(date) FROM price_snapshots
) - INTERVAL '7 days'
LIMIT 50

SELECT avg_price AS avg_price_eur
FROM mv_daily_market_index
WHERE category = 'phone'
  AND date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM price_snapshots)
LIMIT 50

SELECT brand, product_count
FROM mv_brand_summary
WHERE category = 'phone'
ORDER BY product_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT median_price
FROM mv_brand_summary
WHERE category = 'tablet'
  AND brand = 'Apple'
LIMIT 50

WITH latest_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS d FROM price_snapshots
)
SELECT
    p.product_name,
    p.brand,
    p.model,
    m.price_eur,
    m.last_price_date,
    m.rating,
    m.reviews,
    m.skroutz_link
FROM mv_latest_prices m
JOIN products p ON p.id = m.id
JOIN latest_date ld ON 1=1
WHERE m.last_price_date = ld.d
  AND p.last_seen = ld.d
  AND m.category = 'phone'
  AND m.product_name ILIKE '%iPhone 15%'
ORDER BY m.price_eur ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

WITH cheapest AS (
  SELECT ps.product_id
  FROM price_snapshots ps
  JOIN products p ON p.id = ps.product_id
  WHERE p.product_name ILIKE '%Samsung Galaxy S24%'
    AND ps.price_eur IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY ps.price_eur NULLS LAST
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT p.product_name,
       p.brand,
       p.model,
       f.all_time_low AS lowest_price
FROM cheapest c
JOIN products p ON p.id = c.product_id
JOIN mv_price_floor f ON f.product_id = c.product_id
ORDER BY lowest_price
LIMIT 1

WITH latest_date AS (
  SELECT MAX(date) AS max_date FROM price_snapshots
),
cheapest AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM mv_latest_prices
  WHERE brand = 'Samsung' AND product_name ILIKE '%Galaxy S24%'
  ORDER BY price_eur ASC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  p.product_name,
  p.brand,
  ps.date,
  ps.price_eur,
  ps.rating,
  ps.reviews
FROM price_snapshots ps
JOIN products p ON ps.product_id = p.id
JOIN cheapest c ON ps.product_id = c.id
JOIN latest_date ld ON true
WHERE ps.date >= ld.max_date - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND ps.date <= ld.max_date
ORDER BY ps.date ASC
LIMIT 50

SELECT COUNT(*) AS smartwatches_below_50
FROM mv_latest_prices
WHERE category = 'smartwatch'
  AND price_eur < 50
  AND last_price_date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM price_snapshots)
LIMIT 50

SELECT
    product_name,
    brand,
    model,
    rating,
    reviews,
    price_eur
FROM mv_latest_prices
WHERE category = 'laptop'
  AND reviews > 50
ORDER BY rating DESC, price_eur NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS falling_products
FROM mv_price_trend_direction
WHERE trend = 'falling'
LIMIT 50

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS last_date
    FROM price_snapshots
)
SELECT
    date,
    avg_price
FROM mv_daily_market_index
WHERE category = 'tablet'
  AND date IN (
      (SELECT last_date FROM latest),
      (SELECT last_date FROM latest) - INTERVAL '30 days'
  )
ORDER BY date
LIMIT 50

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM products p
WHERE p.category = 'phone'
  AND p.ram_gb = 16
  AND p.last_seen = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM price_snapshots)
LIMIT 50

SELECT 'NO_DATA' AS no_data WHERE false
LIMIT 50
